 Han So Hee and Lee Do Hyun are coming to Manila this November!
 Calling all K-drama fans! South Korean stars Han So Hee and Lee Do Hyun are making their way back to Manila!
 On Instagram, fashion retailer Musinsa Standard announced that So Hee and Do Hyun will attend the grand opening of its store on November 26 at the Activity Center of Glorietta in Makati City.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by MUSINSA STANDARD Philippines (@musinsa_standard_ph) 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by MUSINSA STANDARD Philippines (@musinsa_standard_ph) 
 So Hee previously visited Manila in 2025 for her “2025 HAN SO HEE 1ST FANMEETING WORLD TOUR.” 
 She is known for her roles in K-dramas such as Gyeongseong Creature, The World of the Married, 100 Days My Prince , Reunited Worlds , among others. She was also nominated for Best Actress at the 56th Baeksang Arts Awards for her performance in The World of the Married .
 Meanwhile, Do Hyun last visited Manila in 2025 for his “Re DO HYUN” fan meeting, the same year he was discharged from his mandatory military service.
 He has starred in several popular K-dramas, including Hotel del Luna, The Glory, 18 Again, Sweet Home , and The Good Bad Mother .
